a.title: Apple announces the HomePod Mini 2, but it isn’t ready for Siri AI at launch

b.lede: The new $149 HomePod mini with Siri AI and a 'SoundGlow' visual feature will be available starting October 30.
b.title: Apple refreshes its HomePod mini with a new chip and $149 price tag
